summary: End-to-end verification of the unified '📇 Contacto desde tu tarjeta' lead card and structured Smart-Card lead fields. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass (CONNECT lead writes lead_type+interests+preferred_contact+lead_source+project_request; ESTIMATE lead with photo writes project_photo_path and is retrievable via /api/clients/{id}/project-photo; EMAIL variant persists; legacy 'Connect Demo Maria' has all backfilled fields; manually-created clients carry NO lead_source/lead_type/interests). Frontend (Playwright against the public preview URL): all 6 scenarios PASS — (1) CONNECT lead: client-lead-card with badge 'Quiere conectar', interests chips Roof Repair + Painting, project text present, client-lead-contact-btn href starts with 'https://wa.me/5551230001'. (2) ESTIMATE lead: badge 'Pidió cotización', client-project-text 'Reemplazar techo 1500 sqft.', client-project-photo renders (data:image/jpeg…), contact-btn href starts with 'tel:5551230002'. (3) project-create-quote-btn navigates to /quotes/nuevo?client_id=...&ai=1 with quote-prefill-note visible, quote-ai-description prefilled with the project text, and quote-use-client-photo button present. (4) EMAIL variant: href starts with 'mailto:qa+em@example.com'. (5) SMS/text variant: href starts with 'sms:5551239876'. (6) LEGACY 'Connect Demo Maria': client-lead-card renders with badge 'Quiere conectar', interests Roof Repair + Gutter Cleaning, contact-btn href https://wa.me/5553334444 — proving the migration/backfill landed. Regression: a freshly created manual client (no Smart Card lead) does NOT render client-lead-card and the client detail page still loads cleanly (heading + tabs visible). All acceptance criteria met. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: ClientDetail.js render condition `(client.lead_source === 'smart_card' || client.project_request || (client.interests && client.interests.length > 0))` correctly gates the unified card and prevents false positives on manual clients — verified in regression.

preferredContact map in ClientDetail.js handles all 5 keys (whatsapp/text/sms/email/phone) and returns null when phone/email are missing, which gracefully hides the action button. Confirmed for all 4 variants tested.

server.public_card_lead persists ALL 6 structured fields (lead_type, interests, preferred_contact, lead_source='smart_card', project_request, project_photo_path) onto the created client doc, in addition to the card_leads document — consistent with the unified-card contract.

The lead photo upload block (server.py:4049-4062) still swallows storage errors silently and stores photo_path=None. Same observation as iter_33; non-blocking but worth a follow-up so contractors are warned when a photo upload fails.
Interests are rendered without separators in the test (`'Roof RepairPainting'` from text_content), but visually each chip is a separate pill (verified via screenshot). Functional, no fix needed.
